name: Caterpillar Work Tools - Wamego KS Plant & Distribution
type: Manufacturing & distribution facility (machine attachments / work tools)

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (GEOMETRIC_CENTER, movedMeters 49) sits on the campus - accurate. Confirmed via Wamego EDC for-sale brochure and Panjiva (Caterpillar Work Tools Inc., 400 Work Tools Dr). A 258,112 sq ft crane-served production plant on a ~44-acre core parcel; produces ~50,000 part types - buckets, blades, hooks, brackets - for excavators and large wheel loaders. Note: Caterpillar announced a 2024 closure with Solar Turbines (a Cat subsidiary) taking over operations; same facility.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open heavy-industrial campus - the production buildings, pole-barn covered storage, and vast outdoor steel laydown yards front directly onto internal/public streets. No perimeter fence or guarded truck gate was positively imaged. Set false - flagged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth imaged anywhere on the campus.
fieldNotes.type: Crane-served heavy-fabrication plant, not a conventional DC. Moderate dock activity at the production buildings; the dominant feature is extensive outdoor laydown of finished steel work-tool products.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Modest dock activity along the production-building faces; estimated ~12 doors, 10-25 band - flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very extensive outdoor laydown - hundreds of stacks of finished work-tool products and steel - across multiple large yards. dropArea 50+, dropYard true.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of ~9 distinct buildings (production buildings, office, pole-barn covered-storage rows).
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE - a rail line runs along the S/SE edge of the property and the EDC brochure explicitly lists rail access; oversized steel ships by rail.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - Wamego KS is a small town; the plant is on the edge of town beside a river/lake with adjacent farmland and small residential streets.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~104 acres for the full developed campus including all laydown yards from the perimeter box; the EDC brochure cites a ~44-acre core production parcel plus ~37 additional acres available.
